title: Pre-approval call: Dana Whitfield
transcript:
Renata: Hi Dana, it's Renata at Tallbrook Home Loans. Do you have a few minutes to go over your pre-approval?
Dana: Yes, absolutely. We've been waiting to hear.
Renata: Good news first. You're approved up to four hundred twenty five thousand dollars.
Dana: Oh wow. That's more than I expected, honestly.
Renata: Now, approved up to is a ceiling, not a target. Let's talk about what feels comfortable. At that price your payment would be around thirty one fifty a month, with taxes and insurance included.
Dana: Okay. We pay twenty four hundred right now in rent, so that's a jump.
Renata: It is, and I'd rather you see that now than after you've fallen in love with a house. A smaller price brings that number down fast.
Dana: Let me talk to my husband about where we want to land.
Renata: Of course. On the rate, today I'm seeing between six and a quarter and six and five eighths, depending on points and the day we lock.
Dana: And what do we need to bring to closing?
Renata: Plan on about eighteen thousand to close. That covers your down payment, the lender fees, and the prepaid items like the first year of insurance.
Dana: Eighteen, okay. We have that saved, but I want to keep a cushion.
Renata: Smart. Keep the cushion. Marcus on my team will send the fee sheet today so you can see every line of that eighteen.
Dana: Perfect. Please send it to my work address, I check that one more.
Marcus: Hi Dana, Marcus here. I'll send the fee sheet today and mark it so it's easy to find.
Dana: Thank you, Marcus.
Renata: One more thing. Your offer on the Elm Street house is waiting on the appraisal. I'll call you Thursday after the appraisal comes back, and we'll decide on locking the rate then.
Dana: Thursday works. I'll have my husband on the line too.
Renata: Great. If anything changes before then, like a new job or a big purchase, tell me right away.
Dana: Will do. Thanks, Renata.
Renata: Talk Thursday.
